posts.title: How to Get Started Contributing to Open Source
posts.description: "I hear, and I forget I see, and I remember I do, and I understand." I was recently asked how to get started contributing to open source. The following is my step-by-step recommendation: Pick an open-source project that you enjoy using Learn how to build it + run it from from source Make a change -- any change -- to a visible part of the application.
